q: Describe how the rate of change has altered.
It fell fast until about 1960 (2 years), then more slowly (less than 1 year in 60 years).
Suggest a reason for the trend, and explain why the data cannot prove the cause.
Better nutrition and health (more body fat signals the body to start puberty). The data only show a trend over time; many things changed together, so it is a correlation.
